questions.question: When David felt overwhelmed by fear and by his enemies, what did he wish he had?
When a close friend turned against him, what did David do?

answers.text: He asked the king for help

questions.question: David wrote that a false friend's speech was smooth as butter, but war was in his heart. What did this mean?

answers.text: His words sounded kind but he meant harm
His words sounded harsh but he meant well
His words were true but he rarely spoke
